top_stories.title: Quote of the day by Gad Saad: “Anyone who is willing to end a relationship because of a reasoned difference of opinion is not worthy of…” | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Gad Saad**'s quote, "Anyone who is willing to end a relationship because of a reasoned difference of opinion is not worthy of your friendship," challenges the modern tendency to view disagreement as an automatic threat to a relationship.  The quote emphasizes that meaningful friendships should be resilient enough to withstand intellectual differences and are built on respect, trust, and mutual goodwill rather than ideological uniformity. While disagreements can be valuable for growth, they shouldn't lead to the destruction of a relationship if handled with respect and understanding.

top_stories.title: Who is Indian-origin Nithya Raman who made Donald Trump, Elon Musk jittery over LA mayor primary? - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** and **Elon Musk** have revived their election fraud claims in the Los Angeles mayoral primary, despite an ongoing count that has projected **Karen Bass** and **Nithya Raman** to advance to a run-off.  **Nithya Raman**, a progressive who is now second in the race, initially faced challenges but has surged ahead of Republican candidate **Spencer Pratt**. The Department of Justice sent an Assistant U.S. Attorney to observe vote counting, while **California Attorney General Rob Bonta** reassured the public about election integrity.

top_stories.title: Moon Fashion: After Jeff Bezos' wife Lauren Sanchez's designer spaceflight look, NASA astronauts could wear Prada on the Moon | - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Prada** and **Axiom Space**, a commercial space company, have partnered to develop a next-generation spacesuit component for NASA's Artemis program. The Liquid Cooling and Ventilation Garment (LCVG), designed by **Prada**, is an inner layer worn against the astronaut's body that regulates temperature and connects to the suit's life support systems. This garment is crucial for ensuring comfort and safety during lunar operations, as it sits closest to the astronaut and directly affects their experience. The LCVG is a key component of the AxEMU spacesuit, which will be used by astronauts on future Artemis missions to the Moon's South Pole.

top_stories.title: Phone theft claim, train chase, then a fatal shove: Cops solve Bihar cleric’s murder | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Government Railway Police (GRP)** in Uttar Pradesh have arrested a suspect, **Pankaj Rajput**, for the death of Bihar cleric, Maulana Tauseef Raza.  Raza was fatally pushed from a train in Bareilly on April 26th after an altercation over a stolen mobile phone. The GRP identified Rajput through a video recorded by Home Guards exam aspirants who witnessed the incident and scanned CCTV footage from railway platforms.  Rajput admitted to pushing Raza after assaulting him while intoxicated.

top_stories.title: McDonald’s worker left in ICU after colleague throws scalding oil on him, mother launches fundraiser: 'The pain he’s experiencing...' - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: A **20-year-old** McDonald's employee, Jacob Smith, suffered severe second-degree burns to his face, neck, arm and back after being doused with hot oil by a co-worker, **Jalani Bluett**, 23. The attack occurred on May 30th in Yuba City, California, and police have arrested **Bluett** who is facing several felonies including battery causing serious bodily injury. Smith remains hospitalized and his mother has launched an online fundraiser to help cover medical expenses.

top_stories.title: Dr Melanie Walker says Donald Trump introduced her to Jeffrey Epstein. Then she met Bill Gates... | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Melanie Walker**, a former Gates Foundation employee and doctor, was introduced to **Jeffrey Epstein** by **Donald Trump** in the 1990s. She became close to both **Bill Gates** and **Prince Andrew**, and reportedly vouched for Epstein within Gates' circle after his 2008 conviction.  Walker worked at the Gates Foundation from 2006 to 2017, during which time she allegedly helped connect Epstein to Gates. While Walker has described her relationship with Epstein as coercive, she also warned **Bill Gates** about Epstein's behavior in 2014. The **Wall Street Journal** reports that the relationship between Walker and Gates was sexual, but consensual according to Gates' spokesperson.  The story is significant because it highlights the complex web of relationships that allowed Epstein to remain influential despite his conviction for soliciting a minor for prostitution.

top_stories.title: Radhika Gupta reveals India's next 4 wealth creation themes & why SIFs are the investment product of the decade - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Radhika Gupta**, CEO of Edelweiss, believes **SEBI** regulations have enabled the success of **SIFs** (Specialised Investment Funds) by addressing a need for lower market beta dependence, higher alpha potential, and superior tax efficiency. Her firm's Altiva SIF is on track to become the fastest fund in its history to reach ₹5,000 crore in assets under management. She expects India's economic case to remain strong due to favorable demographics, continued reforms, deepening financialization of savings, and Indian entrepreneurship. Gupta identifies three structural themes that will drive wealth creation: financialization of savings, defense and energy, and premium and discretionary consumption.

top_stories.title: Probe Panel Formed 2 Days After Late-Night Roadside Showdown In Chhattisgarh
top_stories.rephrased_article: A young man traveling with his wife and child was allegedly assaulted during a police checkpoint in Dhamtari, Chhattisgarh. The incident occurred on May 4-5 near the Mujgahan-Potiadih bypass. **Dhamtari SP Suraj Singh Parihar** has ordered an inquiry into the incident after a video of the altercation surfaced online.  The police claim the rider was uncooperative and aggressive, while the man alleges he was assaulted for recording the interaction. The incident has sparked debate about police conduct and the potential escalation of situations during routine checks.

top_stories.title: Hungary Parliament Salary Cut: Charity begins at home: Hungary lawmakers vote unanimously to cut salaries by 40% in rare show of political austerity - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Hungary’s parliament** unanimously approved a bill reducing lawmakers' salaries and allowances by 40%, fulfilling a campaign promise from Prime Minister **Peter Magyar**. The legislation, which also applies to the prime minister, parliamentary speaker, and committee members, will bring monthly base salaries down to around €3,690.  The cuts are part of a broader effort to curb administrative spending and restore strained public finances, following a large budget deficit inherited from the previous administration.

top_stories.title: Trinamool Split, Cracks In INDIA Bloc: Hardeep Puri Says Next Target Punjab
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Hardeep Singh Puri**, Union Minister, stated that the **INDIA alliance** is facing internal contradictions and appears to be unravelling. He cited public criticism of **Mamata Banerjee** by **Rahul Gandhi** and the resignation of Trinamool Congress MP Sukhendu Sekhar Roy as evidence of this weakening.  Puri believes the BJP's recent victory in West Bengal has emboldened them to contest half the seats in Punjab, where they are targeting the AAP government's fiscal irresponsibility, law and order issues, and drug crisis. He predicts that the alliance will continue to struggle, with more constituent parties drifting toward new formulations.
